newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss, German utilities expand cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Swiss, German utilities expand cooperation.

text.p: Electrical power utilities KW Laufenburg of Switzerland and Kraftuebertragungswerke Rheinfelden in Germany said they would intensify their existing cooperation but remain separate entities.

The two groups said in a statement they had taken a first step to boosting their alliance by electing each other's top executives onto their own respective boards, giving each group identical personnel at the top as of December 11.
"KWR and KWL will in future pursue an agreed joint strategy, an extensive melding of organisational units and close cooperation," the statement said.
